summary: Sets out terminology and requirements for the Drone Remote Identification Protocol working group. The goal is to support remote identification and tracking of unmanned aircraft for safety and security, using existing Internet resources. It also covers making identification information verifiable as trustworthy, both online and offline. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Every drone would carry a name tag that others can check, so people know who is flying it.

questions: how to identify drones on the internet
